AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: An Automatic Detection and Statistical Method for Underwater Fish Based on Foreground Region Convolution Network (FR-CNN)
VENUE: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
REGION: Dongji Island, Zhongjieshan Islands National Marine Ranch, Zhejiang, China (East China Sea)
SPECIES: Thamnaconus modestus, Microcanthus strigatus, Oplegnathus fasciatus (+ aquatic plants, unidentified fish classes)
DATA: Own submarine cabled observatory video, Dongji Island (Nov 2020 training; Dec 2020/Jan 2021 test frames)
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'Due to the lack of manual maintenance of the observation equipment from November 2020 to January 2021, sediment accumulation on the underwater camera lens became more pronounced' (per-month mAP, Fig. 9)
D2: Nov 2020 frames random 7:3 (5600/2400); additional temporal test on frames from Dec 2020 and Jan 2021
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: '1000 frames containing three fish species were randomly selected from the underwater monitoring videos of Dongji Island in December 2020 and January 2021.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1/3.1: all data from the single 'submarine cable online observation system' at Dongji Island; Dec/Jan test frames are later footage of the same deployment
C_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'directly using quantity metrics based on multi-category fish target detection in monitoring videos for statistical analysis is unreliable. To address this issue, we convert the total quantity'
E_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'This metric effectively indicates the local area's activity level or relative abundance of fish species.' (Table 6 correlations with environmental factors; no reference comparison)
ARCH: FR-CNN: Gaussian background-model foreground proposals + ResNet-50/FPN two-stage anchor-free detector (Detectron2); compared with Faster R-CNN+FPN, YOLOv5
METR: mAP@0.5, per-class AP, inference FPS, time-averaged occurrence frequency, Pearson correlation with environmental factors
NOTE: D/R depend on policy P2: the main 95% mAP is on a random frame-level 7:3 split of Nov 2020 frames (would be D_ALL=N if only that is considered); a second test uses frames from Dec 2020/Jan 2021 of the same observatory deployment with lens fouling, reported per month (YOLOv5/Faster R-CNN drop up to 5% mAP vs FR-CNN 1%). Per P2 this temporal hold-out within the same deployment is credited under D (D1=조사일) and R1=N. A verifier who regards Nov->Dec/Jan as a different season/water condition would code R1=Y, R2=계절/시기 or 수질/탁도, R3=Y, R_ALL=Y. R3 coded Y because the numeric month-to-month change is reported, but it does not affect R_ALL with R1=N. V: water depth reported (Table 5, 11.8-13.4 m); turbidity only qualitative (Fig. 1); supplementary lights and day/night described (V3=Y); V6=P since performance is stratified by month as a qualitative proxy for lens fouling/turbidity, not by measured visibility. Water-quality sensor measures temperature, salinity, pH, chlorophyll, DO but not turbidity. C5: authors explicitly address duplicate counting of fish leaving/re-entering by switching to time-averaged occurrence frequency (no tracking or verification sample); a verifier may consider this not 'handling' (C5=없음 -> C_ALL=NR). No detection score threshold reported (only 'confidence scores ... consistently above 0.85'). E1=복수: relative abundance/activity index with diel patterns and environmental correlations; no comparison to manual counts. ENV not explicitly stated (open coastal sea, marine ranch with artificial reefs, ~12 m). FPS=Y: 1 FPS sampling for statistics.
